purpose: Prioritize the monitored India universe for subsequent BMS V2 evidence work using reproducible market-price observations.

market_data.production_requirement: Replace or corroborate the provisional provider with a licensed corporate-action-adjusted market-data feed before commercial release.

features.definition: Adjusted-close return from 252 sessions ago to 21 sessions ago.
Adjusted-close return from 126 sessions ago to 21 sessions ago.
Equal blend of 6-1 and 3-month excess return versus Nifty 500.
Share of close above SMA50, SMA50 above SMA200, and close above SMA200 conditions satisfied.
Current adjusted close divided by the 252-session adjusted-close high.
Twenty-session average volume divided by sixty-session average volume, capped before ranking.

ranking.note: The score is an experimental priority rank, not a BMS score or expected return.

market_cap_segmentation.unmatched_treatment: UNCLASSIFIED; never infer size from liquidity

peer_relative_strength.universe_comparison: Difference from the median blend of the official large-, mid-, or small-cap peer group
peer_relative_strength.sector_comparison: Difference from the median blend of the official NSE Indices Industry peer group
